title: R' Sisai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In the Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Maaserot, Rabbi Yochanan spoke in his name. Hyman says he has already explained in the entry Rabbi Simai that the reading should be the same here.[^1]

notes.text: The whole selected Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 1:1 paragraph has Rabbi Yochanan in the name of Rabbi Simay. The supplied heading is Sisai; Hyman refers to his Simai entry and says the reading should be the same here. The full titles in the actual Simay transmission do not establish a full title for the separate Sisai heading, which remains R'. The proposed reading remains Hyman’s, without a canonical spelling or identity change.
